name: Specter
languages: one other language (understands but can't speak)

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.summary: Moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain; 5 (1d10) Force if it ends a turn inside one.
traits.text: The specter can move through other creatures and through objects, treating them as Difficult Terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it takes 5 (1d10) Force damage.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.summary: Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while in sunlight.
traits.text: While the specter is in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.summary: Necrotic touch that also lowers the target's Hit Point maximum by the damage taken.
actions.text: Hit: 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum is reduced by the amount of damage it took.

summary: Drifts through walls to strike from unexpected angles, draining Hit Point maximums; shrugs off weapons.
